video.title: Apollo 11 16 mm onboard film: rendezvous, seen from Columbia (NASA)
video.method: Eagle's ascent stage closing on Columbia over the Moon, through Collins's window. Assumed to be shot at 6 frames a second and transferred at 30, like the descent film; placed by eye in the minutes after TPF, so the timing is approximate.

segments.note: Eagle approaching Columbia, five times speed (approximate timing)

video.title: Apollo 11 16 mm onboard film: docking and entry (NASA)
video.method: Docking: Eagle's ascent stage filling Columbia's docking sight, placed so the closing ends at the reconstruction's moment of capture; approximate. Entry: the fireball through a Columbia window. Placed so the glow first shows at 0.05 g (30 s after entry interface) and brightest near the first load-factor peak, which makes the film run at about 1.5 times real time; approximate.

segments.note: final approach and docking (approximate timing)
